summary: Tested Price Impact Model, AI Recommendations, and Global Ledger features. All 11 backend tests PASSED. Frontend UI correctly displays AI Market Analysis panel with BUY/HOLD/SELL signal counts, market sentiment badge, AI signal badges on product cards, and AI recommendation reasons.
seed_data_creation: Test transactions created via POST /api/nutrition/global-ledger/record during testing (16 total transactions)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Price impact model and AI recommendations fully functional. BUY trades increase price and buy_pressure, SELL trades decrease price. AI signals update based on buy/sell pressure and price trends. Global ledger shows all transactions with price_after_impact field.

features_tested.feature: Price Impact Model - BUY increases price
features_tested.details: BUY trades increase global price by 0.2% per unit traded and increase buy_pressure

features_tested.feature: Price Impact Model - SELL decreases price
features_tested.details: SELL trades decrease global price and increase sell_pressure
Returns ai_signals dict with signal, confidence, reason, trend, momentum for each product
Returns trade_volume dict with buy, sell, net counts per product
Returns buy[], hold[], sell[] arrays with top 10 recommendations each, plus market_sentiment
